# 中国AI模型马里奥赛车测试图谱

## 总览流程
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Prompt["统一提示词\n"]
    Deep["DeepSeek\n生成代码\n"]
    GOM["GOM5.2\n生成代码\n"]
    Qian["千问3.7\n生成代码\n"]
    KIMI["KIMI2.6\n生成代码\n"]
    WenXin["文心一言\n生成代码\n"]
    Run["运行代码并观察游戏\n"]
    DeepScore["DeepSeek 得分 6\n"]
    GOMScore["GOM5.2 得分 6.5\n"]
    QianScore["千问3.7 得分 5\n"]
    KIMIScore["KIMI2.6 得分 2\n"]
    WenXinScore["文心一言 得分 0\n"]
    Prompt --> Deep --> Run --> DeepScore
    Prompt --> GOM --> Run --> GOMScore
    Prompt --> Qian --> Run --> QianScore
    Prompt --> KIMI --> Run --> KIMIScore
    Prompt --> WenXin --> Run --> WenXinScore
```

flowchart LR

```

    Deep --> Speed
